INSCRYPTION-CREATURE_POWER.title: Creature
INSCRYPTION-CREATURE_POWER.description: Takes the hits of the enemy in its lane; damage beyond its HP goes through to you. At the end of your turn, strikes the enemy in its lane, or the nearest enemy if that lane is empty.
INSCRYPTION-CREATURE_POWER.smartDescript: Takes the hits of the enemy in its lane; damage beyond its HP goes through to you. At the end of your turn, strikes the enemy in its lane, or the nearest enemy if that lane is empty.
INSCRYPTION-BONES_POWER.title: Bones
INSCRYPTION-BONES_POWER.description: Gained whenever one of your creatures dies. Some creatures cost Bones to summon.
INSCRYPTION-TOTEM_POWER.title: Totems
INSCRYPTION-TOTEM_POWER.description: Totems stand this combat. Each gives its sigil to your creatures of its tribe.
INSCRYPTION-TOTEM_POWER.smartDescription: [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Totems stand this combat. Each gives its sigil to your creatures of its tribe.
INSCRYPTION-FEROCITY_POWER.title: Ferocity
INSCRYPTION-FEROCITY_POWER.description: Each strike by your creatures deals more damage.
INSCRYPTION-FEROCITY_POWER.smartDescript: Each strike by your creatures deals [blue]{Amount}[/blue] more damage.
INSCRYPTION-HUNTING_HORN_POWER.title: Hunting Horn
INSCRYPTION-HUNTING_HORN_POWER.descripti: Each strike by your creatures deals more damage this turn.
INSCRYPTION-HUNTING_HORN_POWER.smartDesc: Each strike by your creatures deals [blue]{Amount}[/blue] more damage this turn.
INSCRYPTION-ALTAR_POWER.title: The Altar
INSCRYPTION-ALTAR_POWER.description: Whenever you sacrifice a creature, gain [gold]Block[/gold].
INSCRYPTION-ALTAR_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever you sacrifice a creature, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
INSCRYPTION-BONEYARD_POWER.title: Boneyard
INSCRYPTION-BONEYARD_POWER.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Bones[/gold], deal damage to ALL enemies.
INSCRYPTION-BONEYARD_POWER.smartDescript: Whenever you gain [gold]Bones[/gold], deal [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
